column1: # WordNet's pointer symbols and the relations they mean: wninput(5WN), "Pointers", the lists of pointer_symbols for nouns,
# verbs, adjectives and adverbs, which agree wherever a symbol is shared. The symbol is the file's markup; the relation is
# what WordNet says it is, and is the only one of the two a claim holds. A satellite adjective's and an adjective's
# symbols are the same list. A backslash is read here as in an adjective, and in an adverb in wordnet-pointer-adverb.
